# authwise_application (Data Source)

An application of an issuer: something that signs people in or calls an API. On the wire it is an OAuth 2.0 client, and its identifier (`c-…`) is its `client_id`.

Formerly `authwise_client` (kit#968): a `moved` block from `authwise_client` carries the state across, with `client_id` read as `application_id`. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `application_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `application_url` (String)
- `audience_id` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `expires_at` (String)
- `grant_types` (List of String)
- `issuer_id` (String)
- `kind` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `login_url` (String)
- `owning_tenant_id` (String)
- `post_logout_redirect_uris` (List of String)
- `status` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `theme_variant_id` (String)
- `token_endpoint_auth_method` (String)
